pr_title: Allow to disable automatic property linking
pr_body:
Adds a new editor setting that makes linking disabled by default.
Closes #68165 probably
pr_comments: I think to fully closes the linked issue we should add the functionality to retain whether it has been set to be linked or not most probably through some meta property. It wouldn't replace this as what is done here is also good for the first time you see a property editor.

> I think to fully closes the linked issue we should add the functionality to retain whether it has been set to be linked or not most probably through some meta property

This is tracked separately in #73432.

> This is tracked separately in #73432.

oooh didn't know of this one then #68165 is a duplicate of #73432.

I actually had an alternative idea recently. The link status can be easily stored per Node/property using project metadata. I think that's what users more expect. I'll give it a try, it will supersede this PR.

issue_context.title: Node3D Linked scale locks too often
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

Godot 4 Beta 3

### System information

Windows 11/64, RTX 3070, Vulkan

### Issue description

When I turn off linked scaling on a node, I want it to stay off at least until I close the scene. It turns back on every time the inspector updates, after clicking on new nodes. It's unnecessarily annoying. Each node should at least temporarily retain its own linked scaling state.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/632766/199462350-bc676ecd-e137-4468-a6b2-8177bc3eb08d.png)


### Steps to reproduce

* Click a Node3D
* Turn off linked scaling
* Click another node, then back
* Note linked scaling is back on locked again

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: The links are reset each time inspector updates (e.g. when switching nodes).
Ah yes, it's even worse than I described. Thanks. I updated the description.

I just want to agree that this is incredibly annoying behavior.
I rarely, if ever, want this linked feature on the scale transform, but it's on constantly.
An editor option to just disable the whole thing would be very welcome.

> I just want to agree that this is incredibly annoying behavior. I rarely, if ever, want this linked feature on the scale transform, but it's on constantly. An editor option to just disable the whole thing would be very welcome.

I find _linked scale_ good as a standard behaviour. Considering it an option instead of fixing the basic UI problem of "remembering what I changed" is, in my opinion, a wrong approach that creates even more user confusion.

For example, take a look at _rotation_edit_mode_ and change it from _Euler_ to _Quaternion_ ...

![2023-05-12 (1)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/962340/e3affed9-8849-4fe8-92db-b6f5d4fe393f)

This happens for TextureRect scale too.
I change each component of scale differently in code but the next time I run it links again and cant set right scale.
_Edit: It seems to be only an editor issue because it works when running but the scale is being changed by a @tool.
Please see this https://github.com/rakkarage/TestTextureRect for a working ( and by working i mean not working) example where i use a @tool to scale and rotate the texture to fit on screen at runtime and try and fail to do it in editor too (can trigger the code by closing and reopening the scene) Edit: i just wanted to provide an example of code broken by this change and why i think it is not "good" in the hope of finding a solution
worked in 3
ya it is being worked on. thanks.
Thanks.
This applies to all linked properties

review_comments: Should this be cached to avoid fetching editor settings multiple times every time the inspector refreshes?
I'll look into it, but editor properties are instantiated each time, so it needs to be cached somewhere in the inspector itself.

Although things like `"interface/inspector/horizontal_vector2_editing"` don't seem to be cached 🤔
This is accessed once per linked vector property, so I think it's fine to use EDITOR_GET.
